prompts.mole:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D game animation sprite atlas, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 isolated full-body sprites, equal square cells, no grid lines, no text. All sprites face camera-left in the same three-quarter side view.
Input image: character identity/style reference, not an edit target. Recreate the SAME charming stout desert mole miner: round brown furry body, tan muzzle, orange/red nose, round goggles with warm lenses, ragged tan miner clothes, stout short legs and large padded clawed paws, shovel tool. Match the reference's soft painterly children's-adventure-game art, warm brown outlined shapes and gentle textured shading.
Composition: Each cell has one complete mole, same body/head scale, constant foot baseline, centered pelvis. Entire sprite including shovel remains inside its cell with transparent margins. True transparent background; no earth base, no scenery, no drop shadow.
Row 1: FOUR consecutive loopable WALK cycle keys: left foot forward / passing / right foot forward / passing opposite. Opposite whole-arm swing with shovel held safely to the side. Clearly different foot placements, solid planted paws and lifted trailing paws, small weight shift. Not four stand poses.
Row 2: FOUR consecutive DIG cycle keys: lean forward, raise shovel with both thick paws; swing from shoulders; shove broad blade down into earth; scoop and lift dirt away. No actual dirt terrain needed. Consistent shovel handle grip, natural elbows, stout arms of unchanged thickness.
Row 3: FOUR consecutive attack keys: 1 alert crouched anticipation shovel back, 2 fully wound up shoulders rotated, 3 shovel swinging forward whole-body into strike, 4 low follow-through shovel ahead. Tool has same length and blade, claws wrap around its handle. No motion-effect arcs, no glows.
Constraints: preserve head size, very stout limb/paw widths, body volume and clothing/goggle details in ALL 12 poses. Same lighting and camera. No skeletal or thin limbs, no floating disconnected hands, no warped shovel or extra limbs. This is a production sprite sheet: evenly spaced strict 4x3 layout, transparent empty gutters, no labels.
prompts.monkey:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet, exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen isolated complete full-body frames, equal square cells, NO text, NO grid, NO scenery. Input image is an identity/style reference: use ONLY the small BROWN monkey in leather coconut-emblem armor at top left as the character. Do NOT include the red monkey, blue monkey or king.
Recreate that very same charming, slightly mischievous small brown monkey, tan face/ears/belly/palms/soles, big expressive eyes, chestnut swept-up hair, large curled tail, brown leather armor and bracers, round coconut badge. Soft shaded painterly children's adventure game, warm fine colored outlines, gently textured fur; match reference. Keep short sturdy limbs, big hands/feet and same head/body proportions in all frames.
All sprites face LEFT in a consistent three-quarter side camera view. Constant centered hip location, head size and scale, planted-foot baseline and perspective. Blank transparent gutters prevent any frame touching another.
Row 1, FOUR keys of a continuous WALK cycle: front left foot forward with opposite whole arm forward; passing stance bent raised knee; opposite right foot forward/opposite arm; reverse passing. Arms swing naturally from shoulders, distinct feet placements, gentle curl/bounce of the long tail, body weight moves over planted foot.
Row 2, FOUR keys of CLIMBING a vertical rope to its left: left hand reaches high and opposite knee lifts; hand grips and pulls whole body up; opposite hand reaches and other knee lifts; opposite pull. Thick arms and legs, wrists/ankles correctly attached, gripping open hands with natural finger curl. No rope drawn, no armor or hands disappearing.
Row 3, FOUR chronological coconut THROW keys: 1 brings one coconut to chest with both paws and looks at target; 2 draws throwing arm over and behind shoulder with coconut in that hand, torso winds back; 3 whole shoulder and elbow drive coconut forward, hand opening at release; 4 empty throwing arm extends low forward in follow-through. This is an overhand THROW, not a static coconut overhead. Natural connected elbows and wrists. ONE coconut only in frames 1/2, none in 3/4.
Row 4, FOUR subtle IDLE keys: relaxed ready stance, curious glance sideways and ear twitch, small inhale and blink, return to ready stance with happy alert expression. Same stance/body footprint.
Constraints: consistent body volume and visible limb widths, large rounded hands/feet. Preserve exact leather armor/coconut insignia in every cell; no thin arms, extra limbs or joints bending backward. Complete tails inside cells. True alpha background, no shadows, no numbers. Strict 4x4 evenly spaced sprite atlas, one monkey per cell.
